help.title:
❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Please select your question:
help.buy_number: ❓ How to Buy a Virtual Number
help.charge: 💰 How to Top Up Your Account
help.buy_number_answer:
📱 How to Buy a Virtual Number:

1️⃣ Click the "Buy Virtual Number" button
2️⃣ Select the desired service
3️⃣ Select the desired country
4️⃣ Select the desired operator
5️⃣ Purchase the number

💡 Tip: Check your account balance before purchasing.
help.charge_answer:
💰 How to Top Up Your Account:

1️⃣ Via Payment Gateway:
- Click the "Top Up Account" button
- Enter the desired amount
- Use the payment gateway

2️⃣ Via Bank Transfer:
- Click the "Card Payment" button
- Transfer the amount to the announced card
- Send a receipt image

💡 Tip: Minimum top-up amount is 50,000 Tomans.
help.get_code_answer:
📱 How to Receive the Code:

1️⃣ After purchasing a number, press the "Get Code" button
2️⃣ Receive the code from the SMS or app
3️⃣ Enter the code in the bot

💡 Tip: Code delivery usually takes 1 to 5 minutes.
help.payment_methods_answer:
💳 Payment Methods:

1️⃣ Online Payment:
- Direct payment gateway
- Bank card payment

2️⃣ Bank Transfer:
- Direct transfer to card
- Send receipt image

💡 Tip: If you need further assistance, contact support.
help.delivery_time_answer:
⏱ Number Delivery Time:

1️⃣ Typical Time:
- Number delivery: 1 to 5 minutes
- Code delivery: 1 to 5 minutes

2️⃣ In Case of Delay:
- Wait up to 15 minutes maximum
- If not received, contact support

💡 Tip: Delivery time depends on the service type and selected country.
help.cancel_order_answer:
❌ How to Cancel an Order:

1️⃣ If the number is not received:
- Click the "Cancel Order" button
- The amount will be refunded to your account

2️⃣ Cancellation Conditions:
- Before receiving the code
- In case of delay exceeding 15 minutes

💡 Tip: After receiving the code, order cancellation is not possible.
